_templateNotes: Copy this file to a new label file such as ab_crunch_001.json, then edit the paths, split, expectedReps, and reps.
Use issueIds from availableIssues. Use an empty issueIds array for a clean rep.
Files named _template.json or *.template.json are ignored by dataset:evaluate and dataset:optimize.

reps.notes: Clean rep or describe the visible form issue.

notes: Draft label template. Copy to a real label file, review timings/issues, then set reviewStatus to reviewed.

availableIssues.feedbackMessage: Crunch deeper — bring your chest closer to your knees.
Extend fully — return to the upright position.
Keep your neck neutral — avoid pulling with your head.
Slow down the crunch — control the movement.
Control the return — resist on the way back.
